rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=120, pretrain_patience=120, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=400, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). DATA-COVERAGE lever. ONE KNOB: train_n 200->400 (2x), with pretrain_epochs traded 240->120 (pretrain_patience tracked 240->120, early-stop stays disabled) to HOLD the 20-min wall AND keep grad-step parity train_n*epochs=48000 (iter-4 200*240=48000; iter-5 400*120=48000) so this isolates DATA COVERAGE from extra optimization. MECHANISM VERIFIED in solver_itnet_v2.py: build_dataset calls load_val_split(kind,"train",n=train_n) -> a FIXED n-slice subset loaded ONCE; pretrain_denoiser merely reshuffles that subset each epoch (perm=torch.randperm(n)); NO RotatingSubsetDataset / set_epoch. So train_n=200 lets the denoiser see only ~35% of the 579-slice train pool; train_n=400 raises coverage to ~70%. This is the SAME confirmed lever that lifted uswin (200->480, hr 0.3532->0.3829) and itnet_v3 (200->400, hr 0.3123->0.3288) -- itnet_v2 is a fixed-subset trainer so it qualifies. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) TRAJECTORY (hr=metric of record): iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr 0.0 @ep12/tn200 in 170.2s; iter-2 0.5888/hr 0.0 @ep48 in 345.2s; iter-3 0.6230/hr 0.0 @ep144 in 744.1s; iter-4 0.7039/hr 0.0 @ep240 in 1236.9s (val_psnr 25.44, val_rmse 2.672e-3). Best hr=0.0 throughout (LD-FBP floor SSIM ~0.81, above iter-4 0.70). (2) LIMITER: the pretrain_epochs lever is NOT exhausted (iter-3->4 144->240 gave +0.081 SSIM, re-accelerating) BUT it is BUDGET-PINNED: iter-4 ran 1236.9s, OVER the 1200s budget (max_train_s=1150 backstop fired). I cannot raise epochs further. The denoiser is still under-converged AND budget-capped; the separate untrained-DC structural cap (log_alpha never optimized -- itnet.eval() runs the k=3 DC as a FIXED operator, the only optimizer is over denoiser.parameters() in pretrain) is NOT editable (solver edits forbidden). So the only learnable, in-budget lever left is the denoisers DATA COVERAGE. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 200->400, epochs 240->120 (grad-steps held=48000). (4) HYPOTHESIS: val_ssim rises above iter-4 0.7039 because the denoiser sees 2x the anatomical variety (70% vs 35% of the 579-slice pool) at EQUAL optimization, as the coverage lever lifted uswin/itnet_v3. FALSIFIER: if val_ssim <= ~0.70 (flat/down) at train_n=400, itnet_v2s denoiser is NOT data-coverage-limited; the limiter is the untrained-DC structural cap + per-epoch optimization, and iter-6 reverts to train_n=200 and documents the architecture ceiling (hr stays 0; prefer v3). (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min train+score. Per-epoch ~4.155s/epoch at tn200 (iter-2->3 slope) scales with slices -> ~8.31s/epoch at tn400; fixed (214-slice per-sample val + figure) ~145.8s. 120 ep: 120*8.31 + 145.8 = 1143s, UNDER 1200s and within the 30-min sbatch wall. max_train_s=1100 (18.3-min HARD backstop) leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override). residual_learning=False KEPT (the CONFIG default True double-applies the residual and collapses eval to ~0.34).
